column6: Yes / right. Doubled for eager agreement: 对对对！ duì duì duì = "yes yes, exactly!" · 对吧？ = "right?"
Agreeing to do something: "OK, will do". 好的好的 = "sure, sure, got it". Warmer than a plain 好, more willing than 好吧.
A clear, polite "yes, that's right". 是的是的 = "yes, yes, indeed". Among friends people often just say 对 or 嗯.
The listening sound: "mm-hm, I'm with you". 嗯嗯 is the friendly doubled version, very common in chats. A rising 嗯？ = "hm? what?"
Adds feeling: 好啊！ "sure!" (happy yes) · 是啊 "yeah, true" · 你说啊 "well, say it!". Without it many replies sound flat and stiff. After some sounds it becomes 呀 or 哪 (天哪).
Softens a sentence. Suggestion: 我们走吧 "let's go" · guess: 你是学生吧？ "you're a student, right?" · reluctant OK: 好吧 "fine…"
also, too: always right before the verb or adjective, never at the start. 我也是 "me too" · 我也不知道 "I don't know either".
Bounces a question back: 你呢？ "and you?" · "where is…?": 我的手机呢？ · something going on right now, like 在: 他睡觉呢 "he's sleeping" · 我开玩笑呢 "I'm joking" · lively "still": 还早呢！ "it's still early!"
Turns a statement into a yes/no question: 你是学生吗？ Never together with question words like 什么, 哪儿, 谁.
Oh, I see when something clicks. 哦哦 = "ahh, OK". A rising 哦？ (ó) = "oh? really?"
真的吗？ "really?" · 真的！ "seriously!" · 真的假的？ "for real??" (lit. "true or fake")

column3: it's nothing; no worries; I'm OK
column6: Answer to thanks, sorry or "are you OK?": 没事没事 "no worries". 没事吧？ = "are you OK?"

After a verb = done: 我吃了 "I ate". At the end = a change of state: 下雨了 "it's raining now" · 我懂了 "got it!" · 我走了 "I'm off". With feelings it means "by now": 你饿了吗？ "are you hungry yet?" · 你好一点儿了吗？ "feeling better?" (你饿吗？ and 你饿不饿？ are natural too, just without the "by now".) Pattern: 太好了！
Two jobs. "at, in": 我在家 "I'm at home". Before a verb = "-ing, right now": 我在吃饭 "I'm eating". Casual: 我吃饭呢 or 我在吃饭呢. 正在 = "right in the middle of". 还在下雨 = "it's still raining".
not for now, the future and habits: 我不吃 "I won't eat / I don't eat that" · 不去了 "not going anymore". 是 → 不是. Never 不有: that's 没有.
didn't, haven't: 我没吃 "I didn't eat" · 还没 "not yet" · 没去过 "never been". 有 → 没有. Contrast: 不吃 = won't, 没吃 = didn't.
just, exactly: 就是这个 "it's exactly this" · 我就在这儿 "I'm right here". "then": 你去我就去 "if you go, I go". Feels sooner than expected (opposite of 才).
still: 他还在睡觉 · "also": 还有… "and also…" · 还行 "it's OK, not bad". (Same character as huán "to return", different word.)
all, both, right before the verb: 我们都去 "we're all going". 都…了 = "already!": 都十点了！ "it's already ten!"
Laughing. In chats 哈哈哈 = lol; the more 哈, the funnier.
Polite refusal of help: 不用，谢谢！ "no need, thanks!" · 不用了 "it's fine, don't".
Answer to a request: 能帮我吗？ — 没问题！ "sure, no problem!"
OK, works for me. 行吗？ "is that OK?" · 不行 "no way / that won't work" · 行行行 "fine, fine, fine" (a bit impatient).
太…了 = "so…!": 太好了！ "great!" · 太贵了 "way too expensive". Keep the 了 at the end.
Brings up something new: 对了，你明天来吗？ "oh right, are you coming tomorrow?"
Lighter than 对不起: for being late, bumping into someone, asking a stranger. 不好意思，… = "excuse me, …"
Never mind, let it go. 算了算了 = "oh, forget it". Can sound resigned.
to joke. Just kidding: 开玩笑的！ / 我开玩笑的啦 · in the middle of joking: 我在开玩笑 / 我开玩笑呢 · 别开玩笑了 "stop joking / you're kidding".
Modest "I'm OK, not too bad": 你累了吧？ — 还好。 Also "luckily": 还好你来了 "good thing you came".
After a verb it makes a request small and polite: 等一下 "wait a sec" · 看一下 "take a look" · 休息一下 "rest a bit".
that one, and the most common "um…" while thinking: 那个…你有时间吗？ Spoken nèige (or nàge).
就是！ "exactly!" when agreeing · 就是… "it's just… / I mean…" before explaining.
and then…: stories run on 然后…然后… It also fills pauses.
Amazed: 哇，好漂亮！ "wow, so pretty!"
Shock or amazement (lit. "oh heaven"). Fine in any company.
Mild dismay: 哎呀，我忘记了！ "oh no, I forgot!" Also when something goes wrong or someone teases you.

column3: come on!; you can do it!
column6: Cheering someone on (lit. "add oil"): before exams, at sports games, for hard work. 加油加油！
Seeing someone again after a while. Answer: 是啊，好久不见！
From English "bye-bye": casual. 再见 is more neutral.
Said before going to sleep, not as an evening greeting.
可以！ "sure, go ahead" · 可以吗？ "may I? is that OK?" · 还可以 "it's OK, so-so".
当然！ "of course!" · 当然可以 "of course you can".
Makes it sound obvious or pleading: 我不饿嘛 "I'm just not hungry!" · 来嘛！ "oh come on, come!" Same sound as 吗, different job.
了 + 啊 in one sound: light and relaxed. 我走啦！ "I'm heading out, bye!" (friendlier than 我走了) · 下雨啦！ "look, it's raining!" · 不知道啦 "dunno~" · 开玩笑的啦 "just kidding!" · 好啦好啦 "OK, OK".
啊 after a vowel, softer and friendlier: 谁呀？ "who is it?" · 你呀… "oh, you…"
A sigh: tired, sad or resigned. 唉，又下雨了。 "Ugh, raining again."
For things you don't like: 有点儿累 "a bit tired" · 有点儿贵 "a bit pricey". Not for compliments: say 很好看, not 有点儿好看.
Understated praise: 不错！ "nice!" · 还不错 "pretty good". Chinese praise is often modest like this.
so-so, average: 电影怎么样？ — 一般吧。
The everyday "happy": 我今天很开心. 高兴 is similar, a bit more formal.
fun for games, places and people: 太好玩儿了！
interesting: 很有意思 · 没意思 "boring".
这样啊 "oh, I see" (when you learn something) · 就是这样 "exactly like that".
impressive!: 你好厉害！ "you're amazing!" · 太厉害了！
辛苦了！ "thanks for your hard work / you must be worn out": said to someone who worked hard, often for you.
whatever, anything's fine: 吃什么？ — 随便。 Careful: it can sound like you don't care.
Old-school modest reply to praise: 哪里哪里 "oh, not at all". Many young people just say 谢谢 or 哈哈.
Getting attention: 嘿！你也在这儿？ "hey! you're here too?"
Northern spoken 什么: 啥？ "what?" · 这是啥？ "what's this?"

column3: what for?; what are you doing?
column6: Casual for 做什么 or 为什么: 你干嘛呢？ "what are you up to?" · 干嘛不去？ "why not go?"
anyway: 去吧，反正你有时间。 "go, you've got time anyway."
actually… to correct or admit something gently: 其实我不喜欢咖啡。
again for something that already happened: 他又迟到了！ Often a bit annoyed.
not until, only then: 他十点才来 "he didn't show up until ten": later than expected, the opposite feel of 就.
again for the future: 再说一遍 "say it again" · 再来一杯 "one more cup". 再见 = "see you again".
already: 我已经吃了。 Usually with 了 at the end.
Surprise among friends (lit. "I go"): 我去，太贵了吧！ Harmless, but casual.
Slang praise: 牛！ / 太牛了！ "awesome!" (lit. "cow"). Very common among friends.
Internet spelling of a crude swear word. You'll hear it constantly among young friends and in videos, but it's rude: never with teachers, strangers, older people or at work. Safer: 我去, 天哪.
